title: SEAM: Computer-Use Agents Know the Harm Between Screens, and Commit It Anyway
abstract: arXiv:2611.22971v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Safety benchmarks for computer-use agents (CUAs) place the harm either in the intent of the task or on a single screen: a malicious instruction, an injected command, a phishing page. An agent that checks the task and each screen in isolation can pass them, so they do not test whether it combines facts seen on different screens. Yet in delegated work, harm often arises exactly this way: a fact about a person on one screen, a fact about an item on another, and a legitimate task that binds them. We introduce SEAM (Safety Execution Across Multiple screens), a benchmark of such cross-screen compositional harm: 600 multi-step, cross-application OSWorld tasks in which the instruction and every single observation are benign and only their combination is harmful. Minimal-pair variants that differ in one place, scored from the server log rather than by an LLM judge, locate where an agent fails. General-purpose open-weight and flagship agents car

translated_title: SEAM：计算机使用智能体知晓屏幕之间的危害，却仍然实施它
translated_abstract: 针对计算机使用智能体（CUA）的安全基准通常将危害置于任务意图之中或单个屏幕之上：一条恶意指令、一个注入的命令、一个钓鱼页面。一个孤立地检查任务和每个屏幕的智能体可以通过这些基准，因此它们无法测试智能体是否会将不同屏幕上看到的事实组合起来。然而在委托执行的工作中，危害往往正是这样产生的：一个屏幕上是关于某个人的信息，另一个屏幕上是关于某个物品的信息，再加上一个看似合法的任务将它们绑定在一起。我们提出了SEAM（跨多屏幕的安全执行，Safety Execution Across Multiple screens），这是一个针对此类跨屏幕组合性危害的基准：600个多步骤、跨应用程序的OSWorld任务，其中指令和每一次单独的观察都是良性的，只有它们的组合才是有害的。仅在一处存在差异的最小配对变体，通过服务器日志而非LLM评判者进行评分，可以精确定位智能体在何处失败。通用型开源权重与旗舰级智能体……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: SEAM提出了一个包含600个多步骤跨应用任务的安全基准，其中每条指令和每个单独屏幕的观察内容都是良性的，只有跨屏幕组合后才会产生危害，从而揭示了计算机使用智能体在组合不同屏幕信息时可能造成的合成性安全风险。
en_tdlr: SEAM introduces a benchmark of 600 multi-step cross-application tasks where every instruction and individual screen observation is benign but their cross-screen combination produces harm, exposing computer-use agents' safety failures in compositional reasoning across screens.
